messages.content:
Hey — so here's the situation. I can see you've got a `.agentpolicy/` directory on disk with all the right files in it: constitution, governance, role files for backend, frontend, database, devops, notifications, QA, plus the ledger. But none of the contents loaded into my view. Could be empty, malformed, or just a read permission thing on my end.

What I do have is the transcript from our last session — I remember we stripped the CI down to quality-gates-only, killed the deploy workflow, and made sure all five gates (lint, typecheck, tests, security audit, PII scan) stay required because this is a HIPAA stress test and those gates are the whole point.

So a couple of ways we can go. Easiest path: you tell me what's supposed to be in those files and we reconstruct from your description. Or if you'd rather, we rebuild from scratch — I'll walk us through it fresh, faster than you'd think given how much I already know about the shape of this project from the scan.

What sounds right?
